receiver.label_zh: 承受方（右下仰躺併腿斜壓向對方單肩）
receiver.natural_en: Lying on the back at lower right with both legs kept together and lifted diagonally over one of the partner's shoulders, hips tilted tightly.

giver.label_zh: 施與方（左上高位側身壓腿進入）
giver.natural_en: Kneeling deeply at upper left with both of the receiver's closed legs resting across one shoulder, leaning down heavily to lock the angle.

natural_en: Tilted overhead view of the anvil position: the receiver lies on the back at lower right with both closed legs hoisted diagonally onto one of the giver's shoulders, while the giver presses in steeply from upper left.
prompt_zh: 俯視荷蘭角鐵砧併腿深壓：承受方居右下仰躺、雙腿併攏斜高舉搭在對方單側肩上；施與方居左上高位側傾深壓，形成強烈對角折疊線條。
